meta.description: Machine-readable Balluff brand spec for AI visual generation (GLM-5.2 code builds + GPT-Image-2 raster). Derived from design.md in this repo; design.md is the prose authority, brandportal.balluff.com is the true source of truth.
meta.lineage: Seeded 2026-06-21 from ai-marketing/design-system (hermit-crab). ai-marketing remains canonical for its existing consumers (Furnace BI dashboards, beacon decks, Kalli, Builder-common).

principles: Numbers carry claims; rhetoric does not. A sensor that detects to 0.01 mm is described as detecting to 0.01 mm.
Name a specification precisely where it matters; omit it where it does not.
Confidence without bombast. Technical depth made accessible.
Sentence case everywhere; all-caps reserved for the wordmark and the eyebrow tag.
voice.rule: If the spec doesn't support the claim, drop the claim.

color.rule: Achromatic + Balluff Red as condiment. Red is rationed, never a dominant area color. This achromatic-plus-red inverse of the colorful automation field is the deliberate differentiator.

black.use: Primary text; logo on light backgrounds

white.use: Primary backgrounds; logo on dark backgrounds

balluff_red.use: Accent ONLY — emphasis, links, key terms, small callouts, CTAs, active states. Never a dominant area fill.

gray_ramp.note: Derived as tints of #1d1d1b. Cards, borders, dividers, hover, secondary text.

data_viz.scope: Charts/diagrams/dashboards/KPIs ONLY. Never brand-surface, button, or decorative background. Intentionally desaturated.

ui_state.scope: Web/app interactive states only; semantic, not decorative. NOT interchangeable with Balluff Red.

typography.rule: Roboto Flex is the canonical Balluff face, but the FACE IS SURFACE-SCOPED — see typography.surfaces before choosing one. Roboto Flex on web/app/raster/print surfaces that can load or bake in the face; Arial / Arial Black on .pptx and other shared editable-document surfaces. Never pair a second face within a surface (single family is intentional). Hierarchy rides Roboto Flex's VARIABLE axes — weight (wght) + optical size (opsz) + width (wdth) + size — never color alone, never weight alone. Set font-optical-sizing:auto; use condensed wdth on large display headings for display-vs-body character. Headings heavier/tighter, body regular + text opsz; italic for proper-noun emphasis only.

surfaces.note: Surface decides the face. Ruling by Rob 2026-08-04 (shared-internally surfaces get Arial) and 2026-08-06 (Roboto Flex embedding retired for .pptx). This is a deliberate exception, not a shortcut — do not 'restore' Roboto Flex to decks.

web_app_raster.scope: Web, app, HTML/SVG builds, generated raster (customer-facing images, OG cards, PDFs/print) — anywhere the face can be loaded, embedded, or baked into pixels.
web_app_raster.display: Roboto Flex (heavier wght + display opsz, optionally condensed wdth)
web_app_raster.embedding: Load or embed from ./fonts/Roboto_Flex/ (web may use the Google Fonts CDN). Never substitute a system font here.

pptx_deck.scope: .pptx decks and standalone diagram slides — editable documents shared with coworkers, who do not have Roboto Flex installed.
pptx_deck.display: Arial Black (substitute for Roboto Flex bold/display)
pptx_deck.embedding: NEVER embed fonts in a .pptx deliverable. The current Balluff PowerPoint cannot save decks that embed Roboto Flex (Rob, 2026-08-06), so generator embedFonts() steps stay OFF. Arial is un-embedded and renders everywhere.
pptx_deck.why: Two reasons, both Rob rulings: coworkers on shared decks lack Roboto Flex (2026-08-04), and embedded Roboto Flex breaks save in current Balluff PowerPoint (2026-08-06).
pptx_deck.pattern: FONT_MODE=arial switch plus true-Arial metrics; verify fit on dense slides, since layouts measured against Roboto Flex are not metric-identical.
pptx_deck.canonical_source: ~/Workspaces/runbooks/build-a-balluff-deck.md — the deck runbook is authoritative for .pptx generation, including this font ruling. MultiMind .claude/skills/balluff-pptx/SKILL.md carries the code constants.

surfaces.template_modification_exception: Adapting an existing .pptx by direct XML edit PRESERVES the source deck's Roboto Flex font runs. That is fine and is not a violation — the rule above governs decks built from scratch, which cannot embed.

typography.axes: Roboto Flex is a variable font: exploit opsz (optical size) + wdth (width) + full wght range (not just 400/700) for in-family display/body contrast. Flat-weight use (regular/bold only, no opsz/wdth) under-uses the font and is the one real single-font tell to avoid. Axis work applies to Roboto Flex surfaces only — on Arial deck surfaces, hierarchy falls back to size + Arial Black for display.
typography.font_files: ./fonts/Roboto_Flex/ (variable TTF + OFL). Web may load from Google Fonts CDN; raster/HTML generators embed from here. Deck (.pptx) generators embed NOTHING — see typography.surfaces.pptx_deck.
typography.provenance: Scale is PMM-derived (not in Balluff brand sources), calibrated to public balluff.com; examples/00-primary-optical-sensors is the anchor. A future official scale overrides.

layout.provenance: Spacing/breakpoints/radius/elevation are PMM-derived, Tailwind-v4-aligned, calibrated to public balluff.com.
layout.spacing_rule: Balluff favors generous whitespace; when in doubt prefer the larger value.
layout.radius_rule: Square-cornered by default (none for cards/tiles/hero; sm for inputs/buttons). Heavy rounding reads consumer-app, not industrial.

elevation.rule: Flat by default; hairline borders + surface tint do elevation work. Shadows stay subtle even at top of scale.

logo.wordmark: BALLUFF — all caps, custom letterforms. Black on light, white on dark. Never modified/red/rotated; never substituted with a generic typeface.
logo.clear_space: width of the 'B' on every side, no exceptions
logo.b_signet: Red 'B' icon appears ONLY paired with the 'innovating automation' claim, level-aligned at wordmark width; never repositioned independently.

composition_stack: 1. Background — the 'Balluff Room': bespoke pre-rendered silver-gray architectural scene. NOT reproducible from prose — supply a render from balluff-rooms/ as a reference image and compose the subject inside it.
2. Application/industry context — color-graded toward silver-gray to harmonize.
3. Digital element — sparse field of small red dots, once per surface, not a repeating motif.
4. People — DO NOT generate from prose (uncanny faces). Source from Balluff's library and composite. Intent: successful, determined, curious, in action, never posed/centered/frontal.
5. UI graphics — software/dashboards rendered cleanly, no dramatization.
imagery.photography: Products at 45deg inside the silver-gray Balluff Room render, with a soft rim-light 'product glow' + clean drop shadow. Dynamic, never centered. Avoid stock cliches (handshake-over-globe, generic conference rooms, cliff-edge silhouettes).
imagery.reference_images: ./balluff-rooms/balluff-room-studio-0{1,2}.jpg — attach for any image-gen prompt needing the backdrop.
imagery.examples: ./examples/ — public balluff.com captures; 00-primary-optical-sensors.jpeg is the canonical 'what good looks like'. Feel reference, not pixel target.

composition_principles: White space is generous and intentional; if it feels under-filled it is probably correct.
Asymmetric splits (1/3+2/3, 1/4+3/4) express hierarchy; 1/2+1/2 only for genuine peers.
Red-dot pattern is an accent used once or twice per surface, never wallpaper.
Footers are quiet: author/date/page in low-contrast type.
hard_never: Never use Balluff Red as a dominant area color (condiment only).

Never use a typeface other than Roboto Flex on web/app/raster surfaces — no system-font substitution there. (.pptx/deck surfaces are the one documented exception: Arial / Arial Black, never embedded. See typography.surfaces.)
Never embed Roboto Flex in a .pptx — current Balluff PowerPoint cannot save the deck (Rob, 2026-08-06).
Never center titles or body content.
Never use emoji (use the SVG icon set).
Never use gradients/textures/repeating patterns on brand surfaces.
Never invent superlatives; numbers carry claims.
Never generate the Balluff Room from prose (attach a reference render).
Never generate human figures from prose (composite library photography).
Never rely on color alone for hierarchy (weight + size do that).
Never apply the data-viz palette to brand surfaces or buttons.
Never confuse Balluff Red (#e73446 brand accent) with error red (#d32f2f UX signal).

assets.deck_runbook: ~/Workspaces/runbooks/build-a-balluff-deck.md — canonical source for .pptx/deck generation (procedure, failure surface, and the Arial / un-embedded font ruling). Code constants: MultiMind .claude/skills/balluff-pptx/SKILL.md.

routing.rule: Keep final typography + responsive layout in code. Use image-gen for source imagery only; composite real logos + overlay text deterministically.

generation.brand_locking: ./brand-locking.md — how to actually hold Balluff CI in a raster model (reference priming + achromatic constraint + silver-gray grade + code-overlaid logo/text). Read before any image-gen run.
